note: Edit the lines freely. Keep this valid JSON. The app picks one line per calendar day from this list, in order, so inserting or deleting a line changes which day shows which sentence. Rewording a line does not.
lines: you did not lose them. you returned to yourself.
the quiet is not a punishment. it is the room you needed.
missing someone is not the same as needing them back.
you can love a person and still refuse the life they offered.
silence is how you keep the promise you made to yourself.
the urge will crest. you do not have to follow it.
outgrowing someone still aches. that does not make it a mistake.
you were not too much. you were asking to be met.
put the phone down. your future is on this side of the silence.
they do not get another chance to make you small.
healing is uneven. today still counts.
you chose the hard quiet over the familiar hurt.
their absence is not a verdict on your worth.
you do not have to shrink to be kept.
let the message stay unsent. that is a kind of courage.
you are allowed to miss the good parts and still not go back.
the part of you that begged is tired. let it rest.
no contact is not a game. it is a door you closed on purpose.
rain on the glass. you, still here. that is enough for today.
you did not imagine the hurt. you also do not have to relive it.
choosing yourself is a practice, not a mood.
one day of silence is a life turning by a degree.
you can be lonely and still be right.
stop waiting in rooms they already left.
the night ends. you get to come home to yourself.
softness is not the same thing as staying.
you are not behind. you are in the middle of leaving.
the pull you feel is old hope, not new information.
hope can move. it does not have to live with them.
you kept your word today. that is the whole assignment.
some loves are real and still not yours to continue.
do not confuse a long history with a future.
you are building a life that does not need their permission.
the tide goes out on its own. so can you.
peace feels plain at first. that is just unfamiliar.
texting them would be a short relief and a longer repair.
you can want them and choose you in the same hour.
closure is something you practice, not something they deliver.
be gentle with the part of you that still checks.
you outgrew the role they needed you to play.
staying gone is how you keep faith with who you're becoming.
not every bond deserves your return.
you can grieve someone who is still alive.
the window can fog. you stay on your side of it.
your standards did not ruin this. they revealed it.
not forever. just today. just this one night.
you were not hard to love. you were easy to overlook.
leave the thread unread. it is not a door.
moving on is mostly the act of not moving back.
you deserve a love that does not ask you to disappear.
the ache means you cared. the quiet means you learned.
keep your peace where it cannot be spent.
tonight, choose the walk, the water, the sleep.
be a soft place for yourself first.
distance is not cruelty when closeness was the wound.
you already said goodbye. you do not owe a softer one.
let this be the season you stop explaining your no.
the life you want is not on the other side of that message.
you are still good on the days you almost break.
choosing yourself is quiet work. no applause. do it anyway.
